translationRepairs: That year Nan Baoshou and two others passed the examinations.
That year Nan Chengbao and two others passed the examinations.
s0011 names 南承保; 承保 is Chengbao, not Baoshou. The idiomatic already correctly treats 三人 as the named graduate plus two others, so the proposed name fix is accurate.
That year, jinshi Nan Baoshou and three others were passed and granted degree.
That year, jinshi Nan Chengbao and two others were passed and granted degree.
南承保 is Nan Chengbao, and 等三人 means three graduates total including him; the literal wrongly used Baoshou and 'three others.' Both proposed corrections match the Chinese.
On renyin day the army halted at Yanyan Pass.
On renyin day the army halted at Yan Gou.
次鹽溝 is a halt at 鹽溝 (Yan Gou, Salt Ditch); Yanyan Pass invents an unattested place name and misreads 溝.
On renyin day halted at Yanyan Pass.
On renyin day halted at Yan Gou.
The literal likewise renders 鹽溝 as Yanyan Pass; Yan Gou restores the toponym in the Chinese.
On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Shuzhi was sent with a letter in reply.
On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Jianzhi was sent with a letter in reply.
遣監門衛大將軍姚柬之 names Yao Jianzhi (柬之); Shuzhi misreads 柬. The proposed replacement corrects only that name.
On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Shuzhi was dispatched with a letter in reply.
On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Jianzhi was dispatched with a letter in reply.
The literal field has the same misreading of 姚柬之 as Yao Shuzhi; Yao Jianzhi matches the Chinese.
That year jinshi Li Kefeng and three others passed the examinations.
That year jinshi Li Kefeng and two others passed the examinations.
李可封等三人 means three men total including Li Kefeng, so 'two others' is required; 'three others' overcounts.
That year jinshi Li Kefeng and three others were passed and granted degree.
That year jinshi Li Kefeng and two others were passed and granted degree.
The literal likewise treats 三人 as three besides Li Kefeng; the proposed 'two others' matches 等三人.
Imperial Consort Hu of You was buried alive at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
Imperial Consort Hu Nian was confined at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
幽皇太妃胡輦於懷州 uses 幽 as 'confine' and 胡輦 as the consort's name; 生瘞之 applies only to 餘黨. The original invents 'Hu of You' and wrongly has her buried alive; the proposal restores confinement of Hu Nian.
Imperial Consort Hu of You was buried alive at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
Imperial Consort Hu Nian was confined at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
The literal repeats the same errors; 幽 means confine and 生瘞 covers only the remaining conspirators, so the proposed wording matches the Chinese.
That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-three others passed the examinations.
That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-two others passed the examinations.
楊佶等二十三人 means twenty-three graduates total including Yang Ji, so twenty-two others is correct; twenty-three others overcounts.
That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-three others were passed and granted degree.
That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-two others were passed and granted degree.
The literal has the same inclusive-count error for 二十三人; 'twenty-two others' matches the Chinese.
That year, jinshi Shi Kezhong and thirteen others were passed and granted degree.
That year, jinshi Shi Kezhong and twelve others were passed and granted degree.
史克忠等一十三人 is thirteen total including Shi Kezhong; the literal's 'thirteen others' is wrong, while the proposed 'twelve others' aligns with the idiomatic and the Chinese.
That year Liu Eryi and two others passed the imperial preliminary examination.
That year Liu Eryi and two others were examined before the throne.
御前引試 records examination before the throne, not a 放進士 degree grant; 'passed' overstates the Chinese, and 'were examined before the throne' is accurate without inventing success.
That year, imperial preliminary examination of Liu Eryi and three others.
That year, imperial preliminary examination of Liu Eryi and two others.

等三人 means three persons total including Liu Eryi, so the original 'three others' is wrong; the proposal's count is right, but the parenthetical '(三人 total)' is an editorial gloss unfit for the literal field.
